record.summary: dv_{l+1} = diag(W^T dC_post_l W): the pushed error of the closure's post-covariance. Exact v = 1.466e-8 vs deployed 3.197e-8 (10-net LOO). Form is proven optimal given inputs (N1.1), so the whole channel is INPUT error: third-order plane (N1.2, the big leaf), covariance (N1.3, small). HONEST FRAME (T-36, independent 4M truth, r35, F2J-on, deployed 2.704e-8, +-3 points): the 47.4-point 'truth v' ceiling was ~35 points of same-sample noise-matching (12.4 honest, itself depressed by the per-layer truth's own noise); truth planes through the consumer 24.4; the engine's v-arm 8.5 (β 0.4). The v channel is real but smaller than priced on 08-31; the whole v-pool lives in layers 8-15 (shallow 'truth' targets are 76-98% noise).
record.terminal_criterion: Closed when the per-layer dv supply reaches the exact-v ladder rung on the panel.
record.goal_path_summary: Getting each layer's variances right is worth just over half of the remaining error; the formula that consumes the inputs is already as good as the inputs allow, so the work is on the inputs.
